regression.title: Inspector Visual tab crashes app for a node with undefined `visual` (e.g. nodes created via Add Node)
regression.root_cause: src/lib/prism-graph/visual-spec-sliders.ts:83 dereferences node.visual.alpha without guarding node.visual (the rest of the file uses optional chaining e.g. node.visual?.sourceAsset).
regression.precondition: useGraphSourceStore.addNode + applyPlanRendererDefaults (plan-output-hook.ts) seed renderMode/cinematicPrimitives/materialSpec but NOT `visual`; AddNodeDialog passes no visual. Confirmed newNodeHasVisual=false.
regression.repro: Canvas mode -> + Add Node (dialog) -> create node -> select it -> Inspector full Visual tab renders VisualPreview -> buildVisualSpecSliders -> TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'alpha') -> Next.js error overlay covers app.
regression.evidence_frame: 09r-text-content.png (captured the runtime error overlay + call stack: initialFor -> buildVisualSpecSliders -> VisualPreview.useMemo[sliders] -> VisualTab -> Inspector)
regression.note: Intermittent in capture: full Inspector Visual tab triggers it; the compact Inspector card path is guarded and does not crash.
